# TenTwo

> Private contemporary residence near Kandy, Sri Lanka.

## About

TenTwo is a private contemporary residence near Kandy, Sri Lanka, reserved exclusively for one family or group of friends at a time.

The residence is designed around privacy, contemporary architecture, natural light, water, landscape and shared time.

## Property

- Private residence
- Entire residence reserved for one group at a time
- Private pool
- Contemporary architecture
- Floor-to-ceiling glass
- Indoor/outdoor connection
- Shared living spaces
- Private suites (Master Suite, Garden Suite, Upper Suite)
- Rooftop terrace
- Natural light throughout
- Connection to surrounding landscape

## Location

TenTwo is located near Kandy, Sri Lanka.

The residence sits within easy reach of Kandy while offering the quiet of its surrounding landscape.

Distances:
- Kandy: 15 minutes
- Temple of the Tooth: 20 minutes
- Royal Botanical Gardens: 25 minutes
- Bandaranaike International Airport: 2.5 hours

## Guests

TenTwo is designed primarily for families and groups of friends who value privacy, architecture, comfort, landscape and shared time.

The residence accommodates one family or group at a time, ensuring complete privacy.

## Architecture

The residence features contemporary architecture with:
- Clean lines
- Natural materials
- Floor-to-ceiling glass
- Continuous connection between interior and landscape
- Private pool at the heart of the residence
- Rooftop terrace with open views
